sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Shri Shyam Murari, Upadhyay, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri P.K. Malviya,
learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 27.12.2024 registered as Case Crime No.1177 of 2024, under Sections 376(3) I.P.C., Section 3, 4(2) of POCSO Act, 2012, Police Station Kotwali Shahar, District Bijnor.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

Tarang Rathi @ Chhotu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83313019/
1 3.

entities.text: Tarang Rathi @ Chhotu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At the very outset, Shri P.K. Jaiswar, learned AGA on the strength of instruction, raised preliminary objection to the maintainability of the writ petition and submits that the petitioner has not disclosed the criminal antecedents, the instant writ petition is liable to be dismissed with exemplary cost on the ground of concealment of facts, as petitioner is having criminal history of five cases.

4. Once the objection has been raised, we have carefully examined the record and perused the F.I.R.
and we find that the petitioner has deliberately concealed the fact and not divulge his previous criminal antecedents, and even the first information report does not inspire the Court to entertain the writ petition for quashing of the F.I.R.
5.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.

sentences.text: 6. Therefore, the writ petition sans merit and is accordingly dismissed leaving it open for the petitioner to apply before the competent court for anticipatory bail/bail as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
